# External validation: CLEF TAR 2019 (Intervention, 20 Cochrane reviews) — criteria: objectives only

Generated by `benchmark/external/evaluate.py`; plan fixed beforehand in `PLAN.md`. Do not edit by hand.

- CLEF TAR commit `dbc13d02bb3e`; every include plus up to 300 other records per review (a subset of the full-criteria sample, weighted to the review's size)
- 41,996 records in the 20 reviews, 6,237 asked, 510 final includes (937 title/abstract includes); 18 reviews have at least one final include
- Thresholds from SYNERGY+, not retuned: 0.06 (safe, frozen), 0.08 (safe, corrected), 0.17 (98%, frozen), 0.26 (95%, frozen)
- Model jev-1.13.0, 6,237 calls, US$ 0.244; answers sha256 `50f935ec5a60`
- Records without an abstract or not in PubMed (never below the threshold): 361 asked records, 34 of them final includes

## Secondary

- Score alone (no abstract rule) at 0.06: pooled recall 100.0%, reviews keeping every include 18/18
- Title/abstract includes kept at 0.06: 100.0% pooled, lowest review 100%
- Ranking (weighted): median WSS@95 0.861, median WSS@100 0.904, median AUC 0.980
- Final includes below 0.06: 0

## Paired with the full criteria (same records)

- 6,237 records scored under both: correlation 0.874; mean score 0.286 here vs 0.208 with full criteria
- Final includes at or above 0.06 with full criteria but below it here: 0
- Records below 0.06 (unweighted, same records): 18% here vs 38% with full criteria
